Four implants. One fixed arch.
Implants placed
Planned before anything is placed
Implant positions are worked out on a 3D scan using fully guided All-on-X technique, for accuracy and precision.
Illustration, not a patient photograph. Four or more implants are used; how many, and where, depends on your scan.

nodes.v: The Day
Four steps to a fixed arch.
Consultation and 3D scan
A free consultation with Dr. Bennett, plus the imaging that shows how much bone there is to anchor into.
A plan built for your jaw
Implant positions are planned on the scan using fully guided All-on-X technique, for accuracy and precision.
Placement and same-day teeth
Four or more implants are placed securely into the jawbone. Most patients receive their full mouth implants the same day as surgery, with IV sedation if they want it.
Healing and final restoration
Once the implants have integrated, your final arch goes on — the one you keep.

attr.alt: Dr. Gregory Bennett at Arvada Dental Center

nodes.v: The Proof
Every phase, one surgeon

Dr. Gregory Bennett delivers and oversees every phase of a full-arch case himself — surgery, sedation, restoration and the lab portions of implantology. That is unusual, and it is the reason the practice can quote one price and one timeline rather than coordinating three.

nodes.v: The Invitation
Full-arch, answered honestly
<button aria-controls="aox-aq1" aria-expanded="false" class="aox-faq__q">Do I really walk out with teeth the same day?</button>

meta.html: <button aria-controls="aox-aq1" aria-expanded="false" class="aox-faq__q">Do I really walk out with teeth the same day?</button>

nodes.v: Usually, yes. The practice places four or more implants and fits a fixed set of teeth on the day of surgery. The final restoration comes later, once the implants have fused with the bone. Whether same-day placement is possible in your case depends on your scan — that is what the free consultation establishes.
<button aria-controls="aox-aq2" aria-expanded="false" class="aox-faq__q">What if I don't have enough bone?</button>

meta.html: <button aria-controls="aox-aq2" aria-expanded="false" class="aox-faq__q">What if I don't have enough bone?</button>

nodes.v: It is common, and it does not automatically rule you out. Dr. Bennett is trained in advanced options including zygomatic implants for cases where conventional placement is not possible. The scan tells you which category you are in.
<button aria-controls="aox-aq3" aria-expanded="false" class="aox-faq__q">How is this different from an implant-supported denture?</button>

meta.html: <button aria-controls="aox-aq3" aria-expanded="false" class="aox-faq__q">How is this different from an implant-supported denture?</button>

nodes.v: An implant-supported denture attaches to two or more implants and can still be removable. A full-arch All-on-4 restoration is fixed on four or more implants and stays in permanently. See the comparison table above — it is the practice's own.
<button aria-controls="aox-aq4" aria-expanded="false" class="aox-faq__q">Will I be asleep for it?</button>

meta.html: <button aria-controls="aox-aq4" aria-expanded="false" class="aox-faq__q">Will I be asleep for it?</button>

nodes.v: You can be. Dr. Bennett is board certified to administer IV sedation and does so himself, which is a large part of why anxious patients get treated here at all.
<button aria-controls="aox-aq5" aria-expanded="false" class="aox-faq__q">Can I spread the cost?</button>

meta.html: <button aria-controls="aox-aq5" aria-expanded="false" class="aox-faq__q">Can I spread the cost?</button>

nodes.v: Yes. Monthly payment plans are available, and the patient coordinator will go through what you qualify for before you commit to anything. Note that HMO and Medicaid plans are not accepted.
